purpose: Pure source-to-target representation contract for the 859 accepted P10D roles; no database, runtime, import, or classroom activation authority.

identityContract.compilation: requires the exact supplied frozen identity-map bytes
identityContract.repairCompatibility: Repair 1 changes target field/hash/package contracts without changing any logical role or allocated identity; the exact R2 identity map remains controlling and must not be rewritten

contentHashContract.canonicalization: recursively sorted JSON object keys with array order preserved
contentHashContract.includes: resolved semantic target representation, logical source endpoint identities, and source-shape/provenance fields
contentHashContract.logicalEndpointRule: relationship meaning is hashed through exact accepted source endpoint identities and source relationship content, never allocated UUID values

teachingGuide.capability: optional structured field on improved exact Lesson Versions

STANDARD_CATALOG.representation: exact accepted catalog identity, course scope, title, lifecycle and source provenance

STANDARD_CATALOG_VERSION.representation: immutable reviewed official course-publication profile and exact source provenance

STANDARD_DEFINITION.representation: stable course-scoped Standard identity and lifecycle

STANDARD_VERSION.representation: immutable official wording, exact parent statement, Webb level/label, historical repository wording and evidence

ESSENTIAL_STANDARD_DESIGNATION.representation: explicit course/catalog-version designation with recoverable accepted evidence; unknown historical actor/date remain null

CURRICULUM_MAP.representation: stable WT/AWT map identity, lifecycle and source provenance

CURRICULUM_MAP_VERSION.representation: immutable ordered map-version identity and exact source provenance

CURRICULUM_MAP_ITEM.representation: quarter, order, timeframe, focus, Standards prose, targets, criteria, strategies, assessment, duration and reversible source shapes

CURRICULUM_STANDARD_LINK.representation: exact normalized endpoint identities plus source relationship identity, text, hash and R1B basis

COMPETENCY_VERSION.representation: immutable category, display order, exact Standard text, four ordered levels, Student statement and source provenance

LESSON_DEFINITION.representation: stable Lesson identity, WT/AWT scope, numbered/reusable classification, lifecycle and provenance

LESSON_VERSION.representation: immutable exact Lesson content, reversible source shape, separate checksums, reference_only availability, no instructional acceptance, and optional future teachingGuide capability

LESSON_STANDARD_LINK.representation: exact normalized endpoint identities plus source relationship identity, text, hash and R1B basis

LESSON_COMPETENCY_LINK.representation: only the 51 approved WT endpoint bindings with source relationship identity, hash and R1B basis

STANDARD_CATALOG.translation: exact source catalog and canonical Course context

STANDARD_CATALOG_VERSION.translation: source-declared positive version; officialCourseProfile is exact accepted R1B course identity and remains catalog-version authority

STANDARD_DEFINITION.translation: displayOrder is exact accepted source order

STANDARD_VERSION.translation: initial v8 version 1 because the accepted source family has no historical version number; official wording and metadata come from accepted source evidence

ESSENTIAL_STANDARD_DESIGNATION.translation: historical selection actor/time stay null; a future technical import event is separate

CURRICULUM_MAP.translation: exact accepted map identity and Course

CURRICULUM_MAP_ITEM.translation: ordinary instructional collections are arrays; exact scalar/null/empty/missing source shapes remain reversible companions

CURRICULUM_STANDARD_LINK.translation: own and endpoint IDs are exact frozen UUIDs; source relationship identity/hash and approval basis remain provenance

COMPETENCY_DEFINITION.translation: catalogId is the exact source authority plus exact source Course (COMP|wt or COMP|awt); domainCode is the exact accepted source category; no new catalog policy is inferred

COMPETENCY_VERSION.translation: initial v8 version 1; exact name becomes title; exact source levels become ordered Introduced/Developing/Proficient/Advanced descriptors; Draft means unaccepted proposed content

LESSON_DEFINITION.translation: stable identity only; title remains exclusively Lesson Version content

LESSON_VERSION.translation: exact ordinary content uses arrays with reversible source-shape companions; all preserved legacy versions are reference_only and unaccepted; no legacy teachingGuide content is created

LESSON_STANDARD_LINK.translation: own and endpoint IDs are exact frozen UUIDs with exact source relationship provenance

LESSON_COMPETENCY_LINK.translation: only the 51 approved WT links; own and endpoint IDs are exact frozen UUIDs

packageRecoveryContract.commandGate: ordinary classroom commands must reject every role whose package is not available and verified_complete
packageRecoveryContract.readGate: ordinary selectable/Auto Build reads must reject incomplete package roles; authorized reference/audit reads may include reference_only Lessons
packageRecoveryContract.retry: same frozen map and member bytes are idempotent; changed bytes require a new package proposal
packageRecoveryContract.conflict: stale revision or member-hash mismatch refuses the transition
packageRecoveryContract.availabilityTransition: future reviewed transition creates distinct authority and never changes source or normalized content hashes
